purpose: Paired DPReview studio-scene RAW candidates for Sony A7R V to Hasselblad X2D II color-response comparison.

samples.target: X-Rite ColorChecker Classic 24 visible in the fixed studio scene
samples.quality: usable paired-scene candidate; exact studio illuminant SPD and chart reference spectra are not embedded in the RAW

samples.target: The same X-Rite ColorChecker Classic 24 visible in the fixed studio scene
samples.quality: usable paired-scene candidate; exact studio illuminant SPD and chart reference spectra are not embedded in the RAW

interpretation.what_is_now_supported: Both files are valid, directly decoded RAW captures from the same named DPReview daylight studio scene, and both frames visibly contain the 24-patch Classic chart.
interpretation.what_is_not_yet_supported: This does not by itself prove an exact Sony-to-Hasselblad HNCS/Phocus rendering match. Patch registration, raw-domain normalization, chart reference values, and the Phocus output transform still need to be measured.

other_samples.sony_spyderchecker: work/color-data-audit/samples/DSC00278.ARW; valid A7R V RAW but different SpyderChecker24 target and partial-shade conditions.
other_samples.x2dii_classic: work/color-data-audit/samples/B_31325.3FR; valid X2D II Classic chart RAW but its illuminant is not recorded as a controlled standard.
